description:
You are a Systems Analyst at a healthcare IT consultancy. Your team is designing the architecture for a new Electronic Health Records (EHR) system for a regional hospital network. The project lead has asked you to create a 3-page UML design document in Wondershare EdrawMax to communicate the system design to developers and stakeholders. The document must contain exactly three pages, each with a distinct UML diagram type:

Page 1 — UML Class Diagram: Model the core domain entities of the EHR system. Include at minimum the following classes with named attributes: Patient, Doctor, Appointment, Prescription, MedicalRecord, and Department. Draw association lines (with multiplicity labels where appropriate) between related classes — for example, a Doctor belongs to a Department, a Patient has many Appointments, an Appointment generates a MedicalRecord, and so on.

Page 2 — UML Use Case Diagram: Show the system actors (at minimum: Patient, Doctor, Nurse, and Administrator) and at least eight distinct use cases that the system supports (for example: Schedule Appointment, View Medical History, Issue Prescription, Update Patient Record, Generate Report, Manage Users, Send Lab Results, Discharge Patient). Draw associations between actors and use cases.

Page 3 — UML Sequence Diagram: Illustrate the message-passing interaction for the 'Schedule Appointment' use case, showing at least four lifelines (e.g., Patient, Web Interface, Appointment Service, Database) and the sequence of messages exchanged between them.

Apply a consistent professional theme across all pages. Save the completed diagram as '/home/ga/ehr_uml_design.eddx'.
